content.title: Crimson Desert Release Date And Times Confirmed, Pre-Loading Is Live
content.text: GameSpot may receive revenue from affiliate and advertising partnerships for sharing this content and from purchases through links. Korean developer Pearl Abyss will launch its action-adventure game Crimson Desert on March 19, but when, exactly, can you start playing? The studio has now announced the official global launch times for the game, along with pre-loading details, which are now live.You can find all the key information below, as shared by the studio on its website.Crimson Desert global release timesCrimson Desert launches on March 19 simultaneously across all platforms at 3 PM PT (March 20 in some regions). You can see more time zones below:March 193 PM PT6 PM ET10 PM GMTMarch 2012 AM SAST7 AM JST9 AM AEDTCrimson Desert pre-load timesEveryone who has preordered Crimson Desert digitally can now pre-load the game. This began on March 17, exactly 48 hours before the game goes live.Ahead of launch, Pearl Abyss also shared the PC requirements and console specs. The PC requirements aren't too demanding if you're aiming for a 1080p experience at 60 FPS, but once you start looking to push the visuals up to the sweet spot of 1440p or beyond, that's when you'll need to start investing in some expensive PC hardware. PC players may also be interested to know the game utilizes the controversial DRM software Denuvo.On console, players can choose from Performance, Balanced, and Quality modes based on the experience they want. We've now gotten a look at both the PS5 Pro and PS5 versions of the game.Crimson Desert began as a prequel to MMO Black Desert Online, but morphed over time into a more standalone action-adventure single-player game. A report suggests it's on pace to be a big success on at least Steam. Got a news tip or want to contact us directly? Email news@gamespot.com
